description: This file defines the WorkflowStateMachine entity class used within the OrangeHRM core plugin to model state machines for various workflows, including methods, constants, and ORM mappings.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachine
classes.description: Entity class representing a workflow state machine with multiple constants for actions and state properties, ORM mappings, and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the workflow state machine.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the workflow state machine.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role associated with the workflow state.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role associated with the workflow state.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with the workflow state.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action associated with the workflow state.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the resulting state after the action.

methods.name: setResultingState
methods.description: Sets the resulting state after the action.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the workflow state machine.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the workflow state machine.
